description: Dataset for sustainable energy development of biomass-coal co-firing power generation system is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Mengying Wu. "This dataset mainly contains the relevant investment costs of the plant in the design of the biomass-coal co-firing power generation system, the greenhouse gas emissions when adopting the co-firing strategy, and the values of other parameters in the proposed model.". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
